column1: # Do NOT hand-edit: a hand-written row is a guess, and a guess that
# says `public` about a private repository is precisely the failure
# this file is here to make impossible.
# A `# residual:` line records an identity this repository does NOT
# declare and cannot make public from here. The gate asserts the set of
# them EXACTLY, so a new one fails and a stale one fails too.
# An `# unverifiable:` line records a REPOSITORY this gate cannot ask
# about, because it is not on GitHub and there is no client here for
# its host. That is NOT the same as `non-vcs`, which means the entry
# is an archive rather than a repository. The set of them is asserted
# exactly, so a new non-GitHub input fails rather than joining the
# list silently, and no DECLARED input is allowed to be one.
# A non-public row is expected to be TRANSIENT, and it does cost
# something while it is here: it puts the word next to a name this
# file would otherwise only be repeating from the lock beside it. That
# is the trade for a gate that fails when a second one appears, and it
# ends when the row does -- this file is regenerated from the lock, so
# an identity that leaves the lock leaves this file on the next
# residual: metacraft-labs/codetracer-native-recorder -- inherited through an upstream flake's own pin; clears when that pin moves past the commit that dropped the input
# unverifiable: https://spectrum-os.org/git/spectrum -- a git-other repository; this gate has no client for that host, so its visibility is NOT established here
# unverifiable: rycee/nmt -- a gitlab repository; this gate has no client for that host, so its visibility is NOT established here
# unverifiable: ~rycee/nmd -- a sourcehut repository; this gate has no client for that host, so its visibility is NOT established here
